description: Examples of file and symbol names that can be too generic for plain-text search. Use them as review prompts: inspect the target repository's actual search results and local conventions before renaming. Prefer concept-named alternatives when a name produces many unrelated hits.
advisory_symbol_names_note: Review these only when used as the entire name (for example, `create()` or `validate()`). They are often fine as prefixes of a distinctive name (`createStripeClient`, `validateNotificationDeliveryConfig`).
